sections.label: What Is Preventive Care for Adults?

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Is Preventive Care for Adults?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Preventive care combines regular professional care with effective habits at home. It includes check-ups and cleans, early detection of decay and gum disease, fluoride and desensitising treatments, dietary advice, and protection against wear from grinding or sport.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: As we age, our oral health needs change. Gum recession can expose sensitive root surfaces, older fillings may begin to wear, and some medications cause a dry mouth, which increases the risk of decay. Preventive care adapts to these changes.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Is Preventive Care Right for You?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Preventive care benefits every adult. It is especially valuable if you:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have a history of decay or many existing fillings

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Notice bleeding gums when brushing or flossing

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have sensitive teeth or gum recession

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Grind or clench your teeth

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Take medications that cause a dry mouth

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have diabetes, heart disease or are pregnant

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Smoke or have a diet high in sugar or acidic drinks

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Appointment

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Risk Assessment

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We review your medical history, medications, diet and habits to understand your individual risk of decay, gum disease and tooth wear.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Comprehensive Examination

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We examine your teeth, gums, bite and soft tissues. Digital X-rays and DiagnoCam imaging help detect early decay, while gum measurements help us track your periodontal health over time.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Professional Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Your teeth are cleaned to remove plaque and tartar, and treatments such as high-strength fluoride may be applied to strengthen enamel or reduce sensitivity.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Personalised Advice

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We share practical advice on brushing technique, cleaning between your teeth, diet and products that suit your needs. If you grind your teeth, we may recommend a night splint, and if you play sport, a custom mouthguard.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Aftercare and Ongoing Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Consistency is key. Brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste, clean between your teeth daily, drink plenty of water, and choose tooth-friendly snacks. Limit acidic drinks, such as soft drinks and sports drinks, and avoid brushing immediately after consuming them. Attend regular check-ups and cleans at the interval we recommend.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for Preventive Care

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for Preventive Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We believe prevention is always preferable to treatment. Our team uses modern diagnostic tools to find concerns early, explains your oral health clearly and gives advice that fits into real life. We also monitor changes over time, so any concerns are identified promptly.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Interest-free payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Why do my gums bleed when I brush?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Bleeding gums are often a sign of gum inflammation caused by plaque build-up. A professional clean and improved home care often help, but bleeding should be assessed.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: What causes tooth sensitivity?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Sensitivity can result from gum recession, worn enamel, decay, cracked teeth or grinding. We can identify the cause and recommend treatment.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can adults still get cavities?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. Adults can develop decay around old fillings, on exposed root surfaces and between teeth, particularly with a dry mouth or frequent sugar intake.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Is fluoride safe for adults?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Fluoride used as directed helps strengthen enamel and reduce decay. We recommend fluoride products based on your individual risk.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Does gum health affect my general health?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Research has found links between gum disease and conditions such as diabetes and heart disease. Looking after your gums is an important part of overall wellbeing.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: What is the best toothbrush to use?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A soft-bristled manual or electric toothbrush both work well when used correctly. We can show you the technique that suits your teeth and gums.
